camera_audit.split: Seed24 70/30 split of matches consistent within4 native pixels of the existing pose; conditional diagnostic, not independent calibration truth
camera_audit.limitations: Uses only static-background observations. Existing map/calibration may share systematic error. Nearby means closest quartile of matched background points in3D, not surveyed landmarks. No camera changes applied.

mask_audit.provenance: Assistant visually traced polygons from pixel-coordinate contact sheets. Approximate evaluation annotations, not owner labels or independent semantic ground truth.
mask_audit.limitations: Approximate deck-envelope evaluation; excludes wheel protrusions and fills occlusions. Automatic masks target RGB change, not the same semantic class. No retraining, camera modification, or hull modification.

visibility_audit.subset_rule: Trained point centers inside initial hull axis-aligned bounds expanded0.01 normalized units; spatial diagnostic, not semantic labels or tracked seed identities
visibility_audit.limitations: Spatial crop is not an object segmentation. Contribution image tags selected Gaussians white and all others black, preserving geometry/opacity. Difference from subset-only opacity isolates attenuation by excluded Gaussians for this crop. No model edits saved; no training.

scale_render_control.method: Uniformly scale XYZ, Gaussian standard deviations and camera translations; preserve rotations, intrinsics, opacity, SH coefficients. Undeformed renderer only.
scale_render_control.limitations: Approximate deck envelopes for evaluation only. Scaling makes previously clipped points visible; no learned geometry has been repaired or retrained. Other calibration/timing errors remain possible.

scale_fix.factor_rule: Next power of two giving training board minimum depth >=0.3; no validation pixels or geometry used to select factor

before_after.candidate_mask_warning: Old automatic region is incomplete, especially view20. Report approximate hand-traced deck regions separately; not independent ground truth.
before_after.limitations: One run per setting, one nominal instant, selected14-view training subset. Same images/cameras/intrinsics/masks and config; a uniform coordinate scale changes the fixed near-clip behavior. View20 has been used for repeated validation, not a new untouched test.
